create_NUTSProposer: create a NUTSProposer instance with an initial world, target RVs, and adaptive sample count
propose_NUTSProposer: propose a new world state from the current world using the NUTSProposer propose method
build_tree_NUTSProposer: build a binary tree recursively by calling _build_tree with a root node and tree depth
combine_tree_NUTSProposer: combine two tree nodes into a single tree using _combine_tree with direction and mass matrix
check_uturn_NUTSProposer: check if the sampler is U-turning by calling _is_u_turning with left and right momentums
